statement: TC Epic: Spectral Isolation Notation and Estimates, Lean 4 Formalization, and Arithmetic Overlap Observable Contract: (1) Spectral Isolation Notation and Estimates: For step size h_k = tau^{-k} (tau = 2*pi), the unnormalized smoothed explicit formula mode factor is h_k^{1-rho} = tau^{k*(rho-1)} (correcting the prior sign error tau^{k*(1-rho)} across positive and negative k), and the centered observable Y_phi(k) = h_k^{-1/2} * X_phi(k) = sum m_rho phi_tilde(rho) q_rho^k matches the unitary character q_rho = tau^{rho - 1/2}. Integration by parts on the tail remainder r_L(t) against e^{zt} (z = sigma + i*eta = rho - rho_0) yields |eta|^p * |int r_L(t) e^{zt} dt| <= ||d_t^p (e^{sigma*t} r_L(t))||_L1 via the oscillating Fourier factor e^{i*eta*t}, and the untruncated Gaussian completion of the square satisfies |e^{L(z^2+6z)}| <= e^{-2L} * e^{-L(eta^2-9)} for |sigma| <= 1, |eta| >= 3. Combined with unconditional zero counting N(t) <= (t/(2*pi))*log(t) (Trudgian 2014 Cor. 1) guaranteeing Stieltjes tail summability S_{rho_0} < infty, the finite-block spectral isolation limit lim_{L->infty} max_{k in I} |Y_{phi_L}(k) - m_{rho_0}*q_{rho_0}^k| = 0 is proved for any fixed nontrivial zero rho_0 (0 < Re(rho_0) < 1), finite integer grade block I, and eps > 0. (2) Lean 4 Formalization: Six new theorems compile with 0 sorry in formal/RiemannScope/Grade.lean (unnormalized_mode_exponent_id, centered_mode_exponent_id, centered_mode_from_unnormalized, arithmetic_station_collision_ratio, arithmetic_overlap_cutoff_strictly_separated, candidate_bridge_positivity_contradiction), bringing repository compiled theorem declarations to 199. (3) Arithmetic Overlap Observable Contract & Contradiction Architecture: For the two-variable arithmetic overlap observable Q_epsilon^{K, J}[w] = iint w(x) w(y) eta((x-y)/epsilon) dmu_K(x) dmu_J(y) on fixed compact window [a, b], distinct grades K != J have finite disjoint station sets S_K, S_J by Lindemann (1882) transcendence of 2*pi. The minimum station separation d_min > 0 forces arithmetic vanishing Q_epsilon^{K, J}[w] = 0 identically for all epsilon < d_min, while K = J yields positive diagonal mass sum Lambda(n)^2 w(tau^K n)^2. Lean lemma candidate_bridge_positivity_contradiction formalizes the target contradiction endpoint (Q <= 0 and c*D <= Q with c, D > 0 implies False). Under quantitative remainder decomposition Q_epsilon = A_epsilon(rho_0) + R_epsilon, the complete explicit formula forces exact cancellation R_bar_0 = -A_bar_0(rho_0), leaving the conditional spectral lower bound unproved and the arithmetic coincidence bridge strictly open.

variable_domains: K, J in Integer, K != J
hypotheses: Smoothed Riemann explicit formula via Mellin inversion on C_c^infty((0, infty))
Finiteness of nontrivial zeros in compact vertical strip intervals [0, 1] x [gamma_0 - 3, gamma_0 + 3]
Diagonal and off-diagonal spectral mode decoupling across distinct zero frequencies
Unconditional zero-counting bound N(t) <= (t/(2*pi)) * log t for all t >= 14.0 (Trudgian 2014 Cor. 1)
Standard Mathlib foundational axioms in Lean 4 (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound)
object_studied: Whole-spectrum log-Gaussian spectral isolation observable Y_phi(k) and two-variable external-coordinate arithmetic overlap observable Q_epsilon^{K, J}[w]
fourier_normalization: Mellin transform on (0, infty): phi_tilde(s) = int_0^infty phi(x) x^{s-1} dx
multiplicity_convention: Nontrivial zeros counted with multiplicity m_rho
measure_and_window: Pushforward prime measures mu_K = sum Lambda(n) delta_{tau^K n}, compact window w in C_c^infty((0, infty)) on [a, b], cutoff eta in C_c^infty((-1, 1))
order_of_limits: Spectral isolation: L -> infty at fixed finite grade block I; Arithmetic overlap: epsilon -> 0 at fixed grades K, J and fixed window [a, b]
exact_conclusion: Whole-spectrum spectral isolation is established for adaptive Gaussian tests on finite blocks I; Lean 4 formalization compiles 199 declarations with 0 sorry; Q_epsilon^{K, J}[w] vanishes identically for all epsilon < d_min via Lindemann transcendence; Lean lemma candidate_bridge_positivity_contradiction formalizes the contradiction endpoint; and the conditional spectral lower bound remains unproved due to exact explicit formula remainder cancellation, leaving the arithmetic coincidence bridge strictly open.
logical_negation: Unnormalized mode exponent deviates from tau^(k*(rho-1)), or Lean theorems fail to compile, or station separation d_min = 0 for distinct grades K != J, or Q_epsilon^{K, J}[w] is non-zero for epsilon < d_min, or the contradiction endpoint fails to formalize in Lean 4
arithmetic_cutoff: Fixed compact window [a, b] in (0, infty)
spectral_cutoff: Near-band cancellation |Im(rho - rho_0)| <= 3; full infinite spectrum summed with Trudgian Stieltjes decay
integration_domain: (0, infty) for Mellin transform and arithmetic measures
omitted_tail: Log-Gaussian tails t <= 2L and t >= 16L; trivial zero background series tail; infinite nontrivial zero spectrum outside canceled band
tail_enclosure: Cutoff error <= C_{p, chi} * L^{-1/2} * exp(-2L); normalization error <= (1/(2*sqrt(pi*L))) * exp(-4L); background geometric tail <= ||phi||_L1 * (h/a)^{2M+3} / (1 - (h/a)^2)
falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 2: verified unnormalized mode exponent h_k^(1-rho) = tau^(k*(rho-1)), refuting prior sign inverted tau^(k*(1-rho))
Gate 3 & 4: verified integration by parts isolates |eta|^p = |Im(rho - rho_0)|^p from oscillating factor e^(i*eta*t)

Gate 5 & 6: evaluated asymptotic boundary limits L -> infty and eps -> 0; proved Gaussian frequency decay |exp(L(z^2+6z))| <= exp(-2L)*exp(-L(eta^2-9)) for |sigma|<=1, |eta|>=3 (Lean: gaussian_exponent_band_bound)
Gate 7 & 8: proved finite station separation d_min > 0 and exact vanishing Q_epsilon^{K, J}[w] = 0 for epsilon < d_min via Lindemann (1882) transcendence of 2*pi

Gate 9 & 10: formalized contradiction endpoint (Q <= 0 and c*D <= Q with c, D > 0 implies False) in Lean 4, demonstrated exact explicit formula remainder cancellation R_bar_0 = -A_bar_0 on fixed windows leaving spectral lower bound unproved, and proved Gaussian support escaping barrier [e^L, e^(17L)] cap [a, b] = emptyset for L > log b
